per_arm_ceiling_semantics.meaning: Independently enforced per-arm model token ceiling applied to each individual child-process execution.

global_ceiling_semantics.meaning: Aggregate model token ceiling across all four arms in the tetrad block, evaluated prior to each arm dispatch.

headroom_reserve_semantics.global_application: Halt block prior to arm dispatch if global_remaining < headroom_reserve
headroom_reserve_semantics.per_turn_application: Halt child process prior to turn if arm_remaining < max(last_turn_request_tokens, headroom_reserve)

execution_ordering.derivation: Mersenne Twister PRNG in random.Random(2330).shuffle(...) on all_tetrad_arms
execution_ordering.cli_support: Natively supported via --arm-order with comma-separated values (orchestrator.py L2510, L2558)
execution_ordering.recommendation_rationale: Prevents premature block halt at Turn 11 of Arm B, ensuring complete multi-turn data collection on Native and Candidate 4.2 before Candidate 3 reaches budget limit.

order_bias_assessment.provider_prompt_caching: KV cache hit rates may vary depending on arm sequence, affecting billed token tier latency; model output tokens and logic remain invariant.
order_bias_assessment.filesystem_isolation: Total cold-start isolation; temporary directory provisioning cloned from golden commit; zero cross-arm disk bleed.
order_bias_assessment.process_isolation: Fresh codex child process per arm; independent stdio pipes; zero memory or session carryover.

findings.explanation: Global token ceiling (--global-tokens-ceiling 2200000) and per-arm ceiling (--max-tokens-ceiling 550000) are co-enforced via min(max_tokens_ceiling, global_remaining). Pre-dispatch gate halts block if global_remaining < headroom_reserve (45000).
findings.required_action: None; budget enforcement is verified mathematically sound.

findings.explanation: Runner pre-dispatch headroom guard strictly halts streaming process when remaining tokens < max(last_turn_request_tokens, conservative_reserve). Perfectly reproduces Live 02 halt at turn 11 (37,551 < 56,611).
findings.required_action: None; runner enforcement is verified mathematically sound.
